parsed.why: Immigration pride-welcome scheme eases entry for mismatched passports; documented high social acceptance and mature trans care. Negatives: no hate-crime recourse, one tourist-area murder, and birth-sex custody/ward placement documented, though dated and detention-dependent.

No criminalisation of identity or expression, third-gender tradition, pride and community infrastructure. But 2024 reports of harassment of visibly trans people in public and state institutions, rising anti-LGBT rhetoric and death threats leave recourse thin.

No criminalisation, no documented trans targeting, but no anti-discrimination law, no legal recognition, no community scene, thin/dated reporting and weak rule of law give a resident no realistic remedy if outed and harmed.

Documented societal hostility plus state hostility: LGBT school-discussion ban, banned trans commemoration, trans migrants denied documents, violence frequently ignored by police, no anti-discrimination law and no recognition route.

Enforced criminalisation (months to life), sharia death penalty in some zones, insurgent executions documented through 2024, regular prosecutions, no discrimination protection and extreme stigma: outing risks imprisonment or lethal violence.
